results.question: For each department, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any course offered by that department in 2019, what is the name of the responsible faculty member for that course, and what is the average number of enrolled students for all such courses in that department, considering only courses where the maximum number of enrolled students is greater than 5, and only including departments of Mathematics (Course 18) and Chemistry (Course 5)? Do not return any rounded answers.

For each assignable organization (excluding 'ADMISSIONS' and those with organization IDs '138' and '250'), provide the organization name, the average and variance of the HR department codes for its associated HR org units, and the number of HR org units per organization, considering only those with a non-null HR department code. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each school, what is the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the department budget codes among its departments, what is the full name of the school, and how many unique subject codes are associated with the departments in that school? Only include schools that have a department named "Political Science". Do not return any rounded answers.

For the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science), provide the department name, school name, the total number of unique courses they offer, and indicate whether the department is a 'LARGE_DEPT' (if it offers at least 20% more courses than the average among these departments), 'SMALL_DEPT' (if it offers at least 20% fewer), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered in terms where the material status is 'U' and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), and only include those academic years where this geometric mean is greater than the overall geometric mean of total units for all such subjects across all years? Do not return any rounded answers.

For each department, provide the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), and the department phone number. Only include departments that have at least one subject with more than 0 total units, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.

For each academic year, provide the academic year description and the total number of units for all subjects offered in terms with a term status of 'Previous', where the total number of units is greater than 100, and only include subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Additionally, for each such academic year, report the number of subjects that are classified as undergraduate (HGN_DESC = 'Undergraduate'), and only include academic years where at least 60% of the subjects are undergraduate. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each department in the 2022 academic year, provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for letter graded subjects, along with the school name and department phone number. Only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each school, what is the geometric mean of the clearing cost collector values for all departments in that school, considering only departments where the clearing cost collector is greater than zero, and excluding the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Show the school name and the geometric mean. Do not return any rounded answers.

List the subject IDs, the corresponding subject titles from the library, the department names from TIP, and the total number of such subjects per department, for each subject offered in both the library and TIP systems in 2019, where the maximum number of enrolled students in the library offering is greater than 5 and the department name from TIP is 'Chemistry'. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each department that is degree-granting, has a department budget code above 100000, and is not the Political Science department, give the department code, department name, school name, the number of unique courses offered by the department, the total number of units for all those courses, and the number of unique subject codes associated with those courses. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each department (only Chemistry and Biology), what is the average of the range of enrolled students per subject (where each subject has at least one associated course material), grouped by department? Do not return any rounded answers.

For each building type, show the building type name, the ownership type, and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of rooms in building history records for buildings of that type and ownership type that are located on the MIT site, but exclude buildings that are classified as residential. For each building type, include a grand total for all ownership types in the format of (building type, null, total statistics). Do not return any rounded answers.

For each department offering Chemistry courses that have at least one library reserve material and are offered in terms with a term status indicator of 'P', what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students, and for each such department, which term had the highest number of enrolled students in these courses, along with the corresponding term code and enrolled student count? Do not return any rounded answers.

For each department, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, where the department is degree granting, and excluding the Biology and Chemistry departments), and for each such department, list the subject id and total units for subjects whose total units exceed the average total units for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each student in the Political Science department, show their first name, last name, email address, department name, school name, the maximum department budget code for each student considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by last name, and also include the department full name, where the student year is 'G' and the department is degree granting. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each degree-granting department (excluding Mathematics), show the department name, each subject code, the subject code description, the graduate level of the subject, and the average and variance of the ASCII values of the course numbers for that department's subject codes. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each academic building at MIT with more than 10 rooms (excluding the 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'), list the building key, building name, building type, the number of historical records, the total assignable area from the building history, and the average assignable area per historical record, but only include buildings where the total assignable area is greater than the average total assignable area across all such buildings. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each department, list the department name, the total number of graduate students whose department is degree granting, whose student year is 'G', and who are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), along with the school name and the department's full name. Do not repeat the department name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each department, list the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are degree granting and have at least one subject with more than 9 total units, but only include departments that are not 'Mathematics' (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.

For each department, show the department name, department full name, the number of graduate students in that department whose department is degree granting, and the highest dense rank over the school code among those students, ordered by school code. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each department, what is the department code, department name, and the highest number of enrolled students in any subject offered, for departments that are degree-granting and specifically for the Mathematics department, where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000? Do not return any rounded answers.

For each academic year, list the academic year description and the subject code for subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18) that have a total units value greater than the average total units for Mathematics subjects in that academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each degree-granting department (excluding Chemistry and Biology), what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses with more than 0 total units), along with the number of unique students in each department? Do not return any rounded answers.

For each academic year, provide the academic year description and calculate the highest average total units for subjects offered in current terms by each department. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each department, provide the department's full name and the maximum, minimum, and average total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2024, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7). Do not return any rounded answers.

From the top 10 buildings with the highest number of rooms that have area greater than 50 and access level equal to 1 (excluding rooms assigned to the department of facilities), display each building's name, total qualifying room count, the average area of these rooms, and the organization most represented among these rooms along with the count of rooms for that organization. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each degree-granting department that is not the Mathematics department (Course 18) and has a maximum CIP program code among its courses greater than 120000, what is the department's full name and the phone number of its corresponding administrative department? Do not return any rounded answers.

For each building type, what is the building type name, the geometric mean of the area of rooms (AREA) in buildings of that type (considering only rooms with area greater than 0 and buildings with more than 0 rooms), and the average assignable area of those buildings, only including buildings that are academic buildings and are located at MIT? Do not return any rounded answers.

For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, that are in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (Course 6), show the subject ID, subject title, department name, department full name, the course description, and the rank of each subject within its department (ordered by subject ID), but only include subjects from degree-granting courses. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each department and school, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with more than 0 total units, and specifically for the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Additionally, for each school, include a grand total for all departments in the format of (null, school name, average, variance, stddev). Do not return any rounded answers.

For each subject offered by departments in the School of Engineering (excluding Chemistry and Biology), what is the minimum number of enrolled students for that subject, the total number of departments offering such subjects, and whether the minimum enrollment is below 5 ('LOW_ENROLLMENT'), above 50 ('HIGH_ENROLLMENT'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE_ENROLLMENT'? Do not return any rounded answers.

For each academic year, what is the average and variance of the number of students enrolled in courses, considering only courses that are offered in the fall term, have at least 1 enrolled student, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Additionally, for each academic year, provide a grand total row showing the overall average and variance across all such courses in all years. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each DLC in the history department, provide the DLC name, the average and variance of the organization numbers for organizations associated with that DLC (excluding organizations '138' and '250', and only considering organizations with non-null organization number and DLC key), and also report the total number of organizations per DLC that meet these criteria. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each academic year, which Mathematics subject offered in regular terms starting after January 1, 2010 had the highest total units, and what was the range and variance of total units for that year? Do not return any rounded answers.

For each degree-granting department (excluding Political Science), list the department name, the total number of unique subject titles they offered with at least one enrolled student, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects. Additionally, for each school, include a grand total row showing the total number of unique subject titles and total enrolled students across all its degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science). Show only the top 10 departments by unique subject count within each school. Do not return any rounded answers.

List the minimum department budget code, the sum of total units, and the number of unique courses for each department whose name includes 'Engineering', that are degree granting, and that are not the Mechanical Engineering department. Do not return any rounded answers.

From the top 10 IAP activities offered in the 2021 January term that are associated with at least one subject with more than 3 lecture units and offered by the Mathematics department, display each activity's title, the term description, the maximum number of lecture units among its associated catalog subjects, and the subject title with the highest lecture units. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each department, provide the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, and the corresponding school name, considering only departments that have offered more than five subjects, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.

For each department hierarchy level 2 name and organization name where the organization is assignable and the organization is not 'ADMISSIONS', and excluding organizations with ORGANIZATION_ID '138' and '250', give the number of organizations and the minimum organization number, but only for those department hierarchy level 2 and organization name pairs where the number of organizations exceeds the average number of organizations per department hierarchy level 2 name. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of Mathematics department subjects offered in the fall term that are not variable units, grouped by academic year and department, and what is the highest such count for any department in each year? Do not return any rounded answers.

For each academic year, provide the academic year description and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are not the current term, have a term status indicator of 'P', are offered by the Mathematics department, and are full term subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each academic year, what is the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses, considering only courses that are offered in the fall term, have more than zero enrolled students, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Additionally, for each academic year, classify the year as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if the enrolled_variance is at least 20% greater than the average variance across all years, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if it is at least 20% less than the average, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Show the academic year, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance, and the variance_category. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each school, list the department name, school name, subject code description, and the number of subjects offered by degree-granting departments (excluding 'Political Science' and Course 17) that have offered at least one subject in the 'Engineering' school, and include a grand total of subjects per school in the format (null, school name, null, total subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.

For each subject title offered by the "Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog" department with a total number of units greater than 0, and excluding subjects from the Chemistry department, what is the variance of the record count for tip details associated with that subject? Additionally, for each department name, provide a grand total variance across all its subject titles in the format (department name, null, total variance). Do not return any rounded answers.

For each organization, what is the geometric mean of the old department codes for all associated HR organization units where the old department code is greater than zero, excluding organizations '138' and '250', and only for organizations that are not 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST'? Additionally, for each result, show the corresponding HR organization unit title and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each academic year, show the academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18), and the total number of Mathematics subjects offered in those terms. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each type of space usage in the Stata building (excluding usage types that include 'STORAGE'), what is the name of the space usage and the highest variance of the square footage of rooms used for that purpose in any building room, considering only rooms with more than 10 square feet? Do not return any rounded answers.

For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total number of units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student), and indicate whether the department's average total units is at least 10% higher than the overall average (label as 'HIGH_AVERAGE'), at least 10% lower (label as 'LOW_AVERAGE'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each department, what is the average, minimum, and maximum total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that have offered more than five subjects, only including subjects offered by the School of Engineering, and only for departments that are degree-granting and are not the Political Science department? Also, for each department, indicate whether the average total units is above 10 ('ABOVE_AVERAGE'), below 6 ('BELOW_AVERAGE'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.

How many subjects offered in 2021 that are not for graduate credit, are listed as undergraduate in the course catalog, are in the Mathematics department, and are also offered by the School of Science? Do not return any rounded answers.

For students whose year is 'G' and whose department is degree-granting and is 'Political Science', show their full name, email address, department name, subject code, and subject code description, and for each department, also show the total number of such students in that department. Only include students whose department code is '17'. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each academic year, list the academic year description, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units offered per academic term in that year for the Mathematics department (Course 18), and classify each year as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' if the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% greater than the average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all years, 'LOW_VARIABILITY' if it is at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each degree-granting department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in undergraduate subjects offered by that department, and which departments have an average enrollment greater than the overall average for all degree-granting departments? Do not return any rounded answers.

For each academic year, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of all subjects offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the current term and are from the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Additionally, for each department, show the same statistics, and for each academic year and department, include a grand total for all subjects in the format of (academic year, department, null, total units statistics). Do not return any rounded answers.

For each academic year, provide the academic year, the academic year description, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term, have a material status of 'U' in the library reserve, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Additionally, indicate whether the average total units for that year is at least 10% greater than the overall average (label as 'HIGH_AVERAGE'), at least 10% less than the overall average (label as 'LOW_AVERAGE'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.

For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, as well as the school name and the total number of subjects in the department for that term. Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each department, what is the minimum academic year and the sum of total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term and have library reserve material details with material status 'U'? Do not return any rounded answers.

For each department that grants degrees (excluding Chemistry and Biology), what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, along with the department's full name, the school name, and the number of unique subjects offered by the department, considering only departments that offer more than 5 unique subjects? Do not return any rounded answers.

For each floor in the Stata building (building 32), what is the largest room square footage and the name of the building room with that largest square footage, for rooms loaded into the warehouse on 19-DEC-24, with a largest room square footage greater than 100, and also display the total number of rooms on that floor that meet these criteria? Do not return any rounded answers.

For each school, provide the school's full name and, among its degree-granting departments (excluding the Biology department), report the maximum and minimum variance of CIP program codes among their degree-granting courses. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each department, list the department name, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and courses that are degree-granting, and excluding 'Political Science' (Course 17)), but only include those departments where the average enrollment is greater than the overall average enrollment across all such departments. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each department in the Mathematics school, what is the highest number of enrolled students in any subject offered in the term '2014FA' with more than 5 enrolled students? Show the department name and the highest number of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
For each academic building at MIT, give the building name and the highest average area of rooms located on floors with an access level of 2, grouped by floor. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each department, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department (considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student and departments that grant degrees), as well as the school name and department phone number. Only include the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.

For each degree-granting department (excluding 'NIE') in the Mathematics department (Course 18), what are the minimum total units and average lecture units for subjects where the total units are between 6 and 15 or the lecture units are at least 3, and only include those departments where the average lecture units for these subjects is greater than the overall average lecture units for such subjects across all departments? Do not return any rounded answers.

For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the variance of the total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term, have a non-null subject title, are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), and have at least one associated library reserve material? For each academic year, also include a grand total row for all such subjects in the format of (null, null, total variance). Do not return any rounded answers.
For the top 10 academic years by the number of subjects offered in the fall term by the Mathematics department, also provide the start and end dates of each term. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each degree-granting department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in undergraduate subjects offered by that department, and for each department, what is the subject with the highest enrollment and its enrollment count? Do not return any rounded answers.

For each department hierarchy level 2 name and organization name where the organization is assignable, the organization is not 'Cambridge-MIT Institute', and the department hierarchy level 3 name is 'School of Engineering', provide the number of organizations and the minimum organization number. Do not return any rounded answers.

Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and for each department, the minimum number of enrolled students in Chemistry department subjects offered in '2019FA' with course materials and more than 0 enrolled students, calculated in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each school, provide the school name, the average and variance of the department budget codes for all departments and subject codes associated with that school, and also include the total number of unique subject codes per school. Only include the departments Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each subject code and department name in the Mathematics department, where the course is degree granting and the subject is offered in the current academic year, provide the number of unique subject titles, the minimum total units, and indicate whether the minimum total units is above, below, or equal to the average total units for that department and subject code this year. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of all subjects offered in that year by the Mathematics department (considering only years with more than 10 subjects), and for each subject in those years, what is the subject id, its total units, and the deviation of its total units from the average total units for that year? Do not return any rounded answers.

From the top 10 departments with the highest number of graduate students in degree-granting departments, display each department's name, total graduate student count, the school it belongs to, the most common course description among its graduate students, and the count of students in that course. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each DLC, what is the DLC key, DLC name, the number of unique organizations, and the total number of assignable organizations, considering only DLCs that have at least one assignable organization, whose DLC name contains the word 'Office', and that are not the biology department? Additionally, for each such DLC, what is the average organization level of its assignable organizations? Do not return any rounded answers.

For all buildings on the MIT site that are academic buildings with more than 50 rooms (according to the building history) and are specifically the Ray and Maria Stata Center, list each floor's number, the total assignable area on that floor, and the total non-assignable area, ordered by floor number. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each DLC in the history department, provide the DLC name, the average and variance of the organization numbers for organizations associated with that DLC (excluding organizations '138' and '250' and only considering non-null organization numbers and DLC keys), and classify each DLC as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if the variance is at least 20% greater than the average variance across all such DLCs, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if the variance is at least 20% less than the average variance, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each postal code in Cambridge, list the building name, building number, floor number, assignable area, and the total assignable area for all academic Maclaurin Buildings in that postal code. Also, include a grand total of assignable area for all such buildings across all postal codes. Do not return any rounded answers.

For all rooms with an area greater than 400 in the Stata building, show the room key, building room, area, the subject title and academic year of each course meeting in that room that is offered by the Computer Science department, and also include the department name and the rank of each room within its building (ordered by room key). Do not return any rounded answers.

For each organization, what is the highest HR department code (old) among its associated HR org units, what is the HR department name, and what is the corresponding HR org unit title, considering only organizations whose highest HR department code (old) is greater than 500000, and excluding organizations named 'ADMISSIONS'? Do not return any rounded answers.

For each department that grants degrees, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, and only include those departments whose average total units is above the overall average total units across all degree-granting departments? Do not return any rounded answers.

For each organization whose organization level is 5 and is not 'ADMISSIONS', show the organization name, description, the corresponding space unit name, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the space unit name, but exclude organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'. Then, from these results, return only those organizations whose organization name starts with the letter 'C'. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each course in the Mathematics department that is degree granting and has a course level of 'G', show the course description, department name, school name, and the dense rank over the administrative department name ordered by the administrative department name. Additionally, for each administrative department name, include a grand total of the number of such courses in the format of (null, null, null, administrative department name, total courses). Do not return any rounded answers.

For each organization that has a non-null description, belongs to the 'Standard Hierarchy' type, is not the 'Cambridge-MIT Institute', and where the department is 'Political Science' (Course 17), show the organization name, department name, department code, department hierarchy level 2 name, and the total number of organizations in the same department, along with dense ranks partitioned by department long name ordered by department long name. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each organization whose organization level is 5 and is not 'ADMISSIONS', show the organization name, description, the corresponding space unit name, and the total number of space units per organization, but exclude organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250'. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each degree-granting department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (with more than 0 total units), along with the department's full name and the number of such subjects per department? Do not return any rounded answers.

For students whose department is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' (Course 6), show their MIT ID, full name, employee type, email address, department name, student year, and assign row numbers within each employee type group ordered by MIT ID. Additionally, only include those whose employee type is 'Student'. For each such student, also show the total number of students in 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' (Course 6). Do not return any rounded answers.

For rooms with an area greater than 100 and an access level of 1, in the Stata building, show the building room identifier, the room's area, the organization name, the building number, and the building's postal code, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the building number from the building address, excluding rooms belonging to the department of facilities. Do not return any rounded answers.

List the department code, department name, school name, subject code, subject code description, and the total number of unique courses and total units for each degree-granting department with a department budget code above 100000, excluding the Political Science department (Course 17). Do not return any rounded answers.

For each floor in the Fairchild Building, provide the floor number, the building's long name, and calculate the range and variance of the area of rooms located on that floor, considering only rooms with an access level of 1 or 2, and only include floors in academic buildings. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each department (excluding Political Science), list the department name, the number of graduate students, and the number of unique graduate-level courses offered by that department. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each subject offered by degree-granting departments with a non-null subject code description in the Mathematics department (Course 18), list the subject title, total units, department name, and school name, along with the dense rank over the department code ordered by department code. Additionally, include the subject code and subject code description for each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each subject offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5), show the number of enrolled students, the subject title, the academic year, the term code, and the dense rank over the offering department code (ordered by the offering department code), but only for terms where the number of enrolled students is greater than 0, the term status indicator is 'P', and the course has materials. Additionally, only include results for subjects where the number of enrolled students is above the average number of enrolled students for Chemistry subjects in the same academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each academic year and department, what is the average, minimum, and maximum of the total units for subjects offered in that year and department, considering only subjects that are offered in the current term, have more than 0 total units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Also, for each such group, what is the deviation of the average total units from the overall average total units for all such Mathematics subjects in the current term? Do not return any rounded answers.

For all subjects offered in the academic year 2024 by the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject title, term description, and the rank of each subject within its term description group ordered by subject code, but only include those terms where at least 3 Mathematics subjects are offered in 2024. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each department, provide the department name, the average and variance of the total units for all degree-granting courses with non-null total units, and also show the difference between each course's total units and the department's average total units. Do not return any rounded answers.

For each academic year after 2015, how many subject materials with status 'EO' were offered for subjects with more than 5 total units by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
